author: Inside Edition
description: There were tense moments in court as the wealthy real-estate mogul whose boat crash ended in the death of a 17-year-old girl learned his fate. George Pino was found not guilty. Pino was at the helm of a 29-foot boat crammed with 11 of his daughter's friends celebrating her 18th birthday. The boat crashed into a steel channel marker in Miami and flipped over, killing 17-year-old Lucy Fernandez. Another teen, Katy Puig, is suffering from irreversible brain damage.
title: George Pino Found Not Guilty In Deadly Boat Crash

author: Inside Edition
description: A mom called 911 after her baby started choking. She then called a neighbor who happened to be an ER nurse. The neighbor sprinted out of her home and into the action. She immediately began patting Baby Brody's back trying to dislodge what was stuck. What was stuck in Brody's throat? A frozen piece of mango that he was gnawing on to help with his teething gums. Inside Edition spoke with mom Briana Bonde and hero nurse Keosha Stephens.
title: Hero Neighbor Saves Choking Baby

author: Inside Edition
description: Jake Rosmarin hugged his fiance at the airport after spending 42 days in quarantine following the hantavirus outbreak onboard a cruise ship that left three passengers dead. Rosmarin was one of 18 Americans sent to quarantine at the University of Nebraska Medical Center where passengers were taken for monitoring after leaving the ill-fated ship. Settling into quarantine, Rosemarin documented his journey on social media. Rosmarin spoke with Inside Edition after finally being home.
title: Man Released From Quarantine After 42 Days Following Hantavirus Outbreak On Cruise Ship

author: Inside Edition
description: Actor Tyler Mane opened up to Inside Edition about being diagnosed with breast cancer.  He says that he felt a lump in the side of his chest and thought nothing of it until his wife said he should get it checked out. Breast cancer is often thought of as a woman's disease, and while roughly one in eight women will be diagnosed during their lifetime, men can get it too. Mane first shared the news to his fans on social media.
title: Actor Tyler Mane Opens Up About Breast Cancer Diagnosis

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a new use of drone technology, deployed for the first time to disarm a suspect. The Sacramento County Sheriff's Office released this video of the operation. They say they had a suspect's house surrounded, but they feared he had a firearm. Instead of sending in deputies, potentially putting them and the suspect in more danger, they say they deployed a drone to scope out the situation inside. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Sheriff's Deputy Uses Drone To Snatch Knife From Suspect's Hand

author: Inside Edition
description: A truck carrying some 400 beehives upended over the weekend in southeast Texas. It reportedly was headed to North Dakota when its driver took a wrong turn and ended up on a road too narrow to navigate safely. The crash set loose millions of bees. On the scene, beekeepers in protective gear could be witnessed trying to gather the wayward insects and right the disturbed hives. No serious human injuries were reported – though it's estimated only a quarter of the hives will survive.
title: Millions Of Bees Loose After Truck Carrying 400 Hives Crashes In Texas
